notes: Scout Forms Guard keeps no information about visitors. It checks Gravity Forms submissions for spam and keeps only a monthly count of blocked ones. A message it marks as spam stays in that form's Spam folder as Gravity Forms' own data, and a file sent to a hidden upload field is dropped before it is saved. On a form set to "Send only, keep no entry", Gravity Forms' entry, its files and notes are deleted right after the notification goes out.
